about.label: About
about.lead: JOOX began as a family idea.
story: In 2021, after the pandemic, my brother Harry Mata suggested we start a car rental business. With hard work, a loan and a real drive to get ahead, we made the company official and started working in Puntarenas and Cóbano.
Over the years we learned that distance could also hold back our growth and our decisions. That is how the idea of building our own project in Guápiles, Pococí, Limón was born.
At the same time we discovered a new world: importing vehicles. And while looking for solutions for our own cars, we also started importing spare parts from different international platforms.
Little by little, three paths came together:
after: In 2026 we decided to bring it all under one name: JOOX Cars.
But JOOX is more than cars. It is a story of family, learning, work and vision for the future.
And that vision lives at home too. Our children, Joslyn and Josh, help wash the vehicles and are learning from an early age the value of work and of managing what they earn.
Because for us, starting a business doesn't only mean building a company.
about.close: It means building a future together.
